events.title: 복건 후관현 양기촌에서 태어나다
events.titleEn: Born in Yangqi village, Houguan county, Fujian
events.description: 1854년 1월 8일 복주부 후관현 양기촌에서 났다. 지금의 푸저우시 창산구에 해당하며, 집안은 대대로 의원을 냈다. 일곱 살에 서당에 들어가 경서를 읽었다.
events.descriptionEn: He was born on 8 January 1854 in Yangqi village, Houguan county, in the prefecture of Fuzhou, an area now part of Cangshan district. His family had produced physicians for generations, and he entered a private school at seven to read the classics.

events.title: 아버지를 잃고 복주선정학당에 들어가다
events.titleEn: Loses his father and enters the Fuzhou Naval Academy
events.description: 열세 살에 아버지가 병으로 죽어 글공부를 접어야 했다. 학비를 받지 않고 급료까지 주던 좌종당의 복주선정학당에 시험을 쳐 들어가 항해를 배웠고, 이때 이름을 종광으로 고쳤다.
events.descriptionEn: His father died when he was thirteen and his schooling broke off. He sat the entrance test for the naval academy Zuo Zongtang had founded at Fuzhou, which charged no fees and even paid a stipend, and studied navigation there, changing his given name to Zongguang.
events.placeNameEn: Fuzhou Naval Academy, Mawei (modern Fuzhou, Fujian)

events.title: 1기로 졸업해 군함에서 오 년을 보내다
events.titleEn: Graduates in the first cohort and spends five years at sea
events.description: 선정학당 1기로 졸업한 뒤 건위함과 양무함을 타고 오 년간 실습했다. 남양과 발해, 일본까지 항해했고 1872년에는 선용도원 자격을 얻으면서 이름을 복으로, 자를 기도로 고쳤다.
events.descriptionEn: Graduating in the academy's first cohort, he served five years aboard the training ships Jianwei and Yangwu, sailing the southern seas, the Bohai gulf and as far as Japan. In 1872 he qualified for appointment as a circuit intendant and changed his name to Fu, with the courtesy name Jidao.

events.title: 영국으로 건너가 그리니치 왕립해군학교에서 배우다
events.titleEn: Sails to Britain and studies at the Royal Naval College, Greenwich
events.description: 청 정부가 보낸 해군 유학생으로 영국에 갔다. 포츠머스를 거쳐 런던 그리니치 왕립해군학교에서 공부했고, 주영 공사 곽숭도와 나이를 잊고 사귀며 영국의 법과 정치 제도를 함께 따져 물었다.
events.descriptionEn: He went to Britain among the naval cadets sent by the Qing government, studying first at Portsmouth and then at the Royal Naval College in Greenwich. He struck up a friendship across the age gap with Guo Songtao, the Chinese minister in London, and the two argued over British law and government.

events.title: 귀국해 복주선정학당 교습이 되다
events.titleEn: Returns home to teach at the Fuzhou Naval Academy
events.description: 그리니치를 마치고 돌아와 모교인 복주선정학당 후학당 교습으로 부임했다. 함대 지휘관이 아니라 가르치는 자리로 돌아온 것이 이후의 행로를 갈랐다.
events.descriptionEn: After finishing at Greenwich he came back and was appointed an instructor at his old school, the Fuzhou Naval Academy. He returned to a teaching post rather than a fleet command, and that turn shaped the rest of his career.
events.placeNameEn: Fuzhou Naval Academy, Mawei (modern Fuzhou, Fujian)

events.title: 천진 북양수사학당으로 옮겨 이십 년을 가르치다
events.titleEn: Moves to the Beiyang Naval Academy in Tianjin
events.description: 이홍장이 세운 북양수사학당의 외국어 정교습으로 천진에 갔다. 1889년 회판, 1890년 총판으로 올라 학교 운영을 맡았고, 뒷날 대총통이 되는 여원홍이 그의 학생이었다.
events.descriptionEn: He went to Tianjin as chief instructor in foreign languages at the Beiyang Naval Academy, founded by Li Hongzhang. He became assistant director in 1889 and director in 1890, running the school; Li Yuanhong, later president of the republic, was among his students.

events.title: 과거 향시에 거듭 낙방하다
events.titleEn: Fails the provincial examinations again and again
events.description: 서양 학문으로는 관료 사회에서 대접받지 못한다고 보고 돈을 들여 감생 자격을 산 뒤 향시에 응했다. 복건과 순천부를 오가며 네 차례로 전해지는 응시를 모두 떨어졌고, 끝내 거인이 되지 못했다.
events.descriptionEn: Judging that Western learning bought him no standing among officials, he purchased student status and sat the provincial examinations. He is said to have tried four times, in Fujian and in the Shuntian district around Beijing, and failed every one, never gaining the juren degree.
events.placeNameEn: Provincial examination halls in Fujian and Shuntian (Beijing)

events.title: 청일전쟁 패전 뒤 『직보』에 네 편을 잇달아 싣다
events.titleEn: Publishes four essays in the Zhibao after the defeat by Japan
events.description: 북양함대가 무너진 이듬해 천진의 신문 『직보』에 「논세변지극」·「원강」·「벽한」·「구망결론」을 실었다. 무기나 기계가 아니라 제도와 학문을 바꿔야 한다는 주장이었고, 이 글들로 단번에 이름이 알려졌다.
events.descriptionEn: The year after the Beiyang fleet was destroyed he ran four essays in the Tianjin paper Zhibao, arguing that what China had to change was not its weapons and machines but its institutions and its learning. The pieces made his name overnight.

events.title: 천진에서 『국문보』를 창간하다
events.titleEn: Founds the Guowen bao in Tianjin
events.description: 왕수식·하증우 등과 천진에서 신문 『국문보』와 그 증간 『국문휘편』을 냈다. 음력 11월부터 『천연론』을 이 증간에 연재했다.
events.descriptionEn: With Wang Xiuzhi, Xia Zengyou and others he launched the newspaper Guowen bao in Tianjin along with its supplement Guowen huibian. From the eleventh lunar month he serialised his version of Huxley in the supplement.

events.title: 『천연론』을 펴내고 번역 삼원칙을 내세우다
events.titleEn: Publishes Tianyanlun and states his three principles of translation
events.description: 헉슬리의 『진화와 윤리』를 옮긴 『천연론』이 단행본으로 나왔다. 원문을 그대로 옮기지 않고 스펜서의 논리를 섞고 자기 논평을 붙인 편역이며, 서문 「역례언」에서 신·달·아 세 가지를 번역의 기준으로 내세웠다. 초판 시점은 판본에 따라 그해 3월과 6월로 갈린다.
events.descriptionEn: His rendering of Huxley's Evolution and Ethics came out as a book. It is an adaptation rather than a translation, mixing in Spencer's reasoning and carrying his own commentaries, and its preface set out fidelity, clarity and elegance as the standards for translation. Editions differ on whether the first printing came in March or June of that year.

events.title: 의화단을 피해 상해로 옮기다
events.titleEn: Leaves Tianjin for Shanghai to escape the Boxer rising
events.description: 의화단이 일어나자 천진을 떠나 상해로 피했다. 그곳에서 논리학을 다루는 명학회를 만들었고, 이후 번역 작업의 근거지가 상해가 됐다.
events.descriptionEn: When the Boxer rising broke out he left Tianjin and took refuge in Shanghai, where he set up a society for the study of logic. Shanghai became the base for his translation work from then on.

events.title: 경사대학당 역서국을 맡고 『원부』를 내다
events.titleEn: Heads the translation bureau of the Imperial University and issues Yuanfu
events.description: 북경으로 올라가 경사대학당에 딸린 역서국 총판이 됐다. 같은 해 애덤 스미스 『국부론』을 옮긴 『원부』를 냈는데, 원문에 자기 안어를 붙여 중국 현실에 견주는 방식이었다.
events.descriptionEn: He went to Beijing to direct the translation bureau attached to the Imperial University. That same year he issued Yuanfu, his version of Adam Smith's Wealth of Nations, in which he appended his own notes measuring the argument against conditions in China.

events.title: 밀·스펜서·몽테스키외를 잇달아 옮기다
events.titleEn: Translates Mill, Spencer and Montesquieu in succession
events.description: 1903년에 밀의 『자유론』을 『군기권계론』으로, 스펜서의 사회학 입문을 『군학이언』으로, 밀의 논리학을 『목륵명학』으로 냈고 젠크스의 정치사도 『사회통전』으로 옮겼다. 몽테스키외 『법의 정신』을 옮긴 『법의』는 1904년부터 1909년까지 나누어 나왔다.
events.descriptionEn: In 1903 he brought out Mill's On Liberty, Spencer's Study of Sociology and Mill's logic in Chinese versions, along with Jenks's history of politics. His rendering of Montesquieu's Spirit of the Laws appeared in instalments between 1904 and 1909.

events.title: 복단공학 교장과 안휘사범학당 감독을 맡다
events.titleEn: Heads Fudan College and the Anhui Normal School
events.description: 마상백을 도와 세운 복단공학의 두 번째 교장이 됐다. 같은 해 안휘순무 은명의 초빙으로 안경의 안휘사범학당 감독도 맡았으나, 이듬해 은명이 암살되면서 그 자리를 떠났다.
events.descriptionEn: He became the second head of Fudan College, which he had helped Ma Xiangbo establish. The same year the governor of Anhui, En Ming, engaged him to supervise the Anhui Normal School at Anqing; he left that post the next year after En Ming was assassinated.

events.title: 청 조정이 문과 진사 출신을 내리다
events.titleEn: The Qing court grants him a jinshi degree by decree
events.description: 1910년 1월 17일 청 조정이 그에게 문과 진사 출신을 하사했다. 향시조차 통과하지 못했던 사람이 시험 없이 최고 학위를 받은 셈이며, 같은 해 해군부 협도통과 자정원 의원이 됐다.
events.descriptionEn: On 17 January 1910 the Qing court conferred on him the status of a jinshi in the literary examinations. The man who had never even passed the provincial round received the highest degree without sitting for it, and the same year he was made a naval officer of rank and a member of the advisory council.

events.title: 북경대학교 초대 교장이 되다
events.titleEn: Becomes the first president of Peking University
events.description: 2월에 경사대학당 총감독을 맡았고, 5월 학교 이름이 북경대학교로 바뀌면서 초대 교장이 됐다. 빚을 내 운영비를 대고 폐교 논의를 막아냈으나 그해 11월 자리에서 물러났다.
events.descriptionEn: He took charge of the Imperial University in February, and when it was renamed Peking University in May he became its first president. He borrowed money to keep it running and fought off proposals to close it, then resigned in November of the same year.

events.title: 주안회 발기인에 이름이 오르다
events.titleEn: His name appears among the founders of the Chouanhui
events.description: 양도가 위안스카이의 제제를 밀기 위해 주안회를 만들면서 그를 발기인 여섯 명 가운데 하나로 올렸다. 본인은 동의한 적 없다고 했으나 이름은 끝내 빠지지 않았고, 이 일로 여론의 지탄을 받았다.
events.descriptionEn: When Yang Du set up the Chouanhui to push Yuan Shikai's imperial restoration, Yan Fu's name was listed as one of its six founders. He maintained he had never agreed, but the name was never withdrawn, and the affair drew heavy public criticism.

events.title: 고향 복주에서 예순일곱에 죽다
events.titleEn: Dies at sixty-seven in his native Fuzhou
events.description: 천식이 낫지 않아 1920년 복주로 내려가 요양하다 이듬해 10월 27일 낭관항 자택에서 죽었다. 만년에는 오사운동을 지지한 채원배를 두고 시세를 모른다고 했을 만큼 젊은 시절의 논조에서 멀어져 있었다.
events.descriptionEn: Chronic asthma sent him back to Fuzhou in 1920, and he died at his house on Langguan Lane on 27 October 1921. By his last years he had moved far from his early positions, calling Cai Yuanpei out of touch for backing the May Fourth students.
